proofReview.fixedDistance: Each original inverted1/0 pair must swap relative order exactly once, and no legal move reverses that ordering. Thus total distance equals initial inversion count independently of operation order.
proofReview.operationUpperBound: Original contiguous zero blocks cannot split: moving a1 crosses an entire current zero run. Each1 crosses each original zero block to its right at most once, and every positive move crosses at least one such block. The total number of such pairs bounds move count.
proofReview.attainment: Process original zero blocks left to right and preceding ones right to left. Each participating1 crosses exactly the current block in a separate mandatory maximal move; unprocessed blocks remain separated by an original1. Therefore every eligible1/block pair contributes one fee. A block of length z with a preceding ones contributes a*(z+1).
proofReview.complexityAndIntegers: Reference is O(length) time and O(1) extra space beyond input. Move count is at most inversion count, so cost<=length^2/2<=5000000000. Signed64-bit arithmetic is sufficient and32-bit is demonstrably insufficient.
proofReview.bindings: Normalized import schema and frozen checksum verified. Displayed editorial equals batch editorial; authored solutions match displayed solutions, whose Python bytes exactly equal frozen reference. Required standalone correctness-proof heading present.
